newsitem.title: PERU: Explosion heard near Peru electric towers - radio.
newsitem.headline: Explosion heard near Peru electric towers - radio.

text.p: An explosion was heard early on Monday near high-tension electricity towers in the poor Lima suburb of San Juan de Lurigancho, local radio station Radio Programas del Peru reported.
Police told Reuters they were going to the scene, but had no further details.
Peru's Maoist guerrilla group Shining Path has in recent months targeted the installations of electric utility Edelnor with a string of dynamite attacks.

The smaller Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) has promised reprisals for the killing of its members who held the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima. Troops raided the building on April 22, ending a four-month siege and freeing 71 hostages.
